        appointment_id: int,
        payload: AppointmentPatchRequest,

        app = AppointmentController.get_appointment(db, db_user, appointment_id)

        # Idempotence: identical payload is idempotent
        if payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) == app.model_dump(exclude_unset=True):
            return app

        if app.status != AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value:
            raise AppException(409, f"Cannot modify appointment in status {app.status}", "Conflict")

        if payload.room_id is not None and payload.room_id != app.room_id:
            new_room = db.query(RoomModel).filter(
                RoomModel.id == payload.room_id,
                RoomModel.is_deleted == False,
            ).first()
            if not new_room:
                raise AppException(404, f"Room {payload.room_id} not found", "Not Found")
            app.room_id = payload.room_id

        if payload.start_at is not None or payload.end_at is not None:
            s_utc = payload.start_at or app.start_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            e_utc = payload.end_at or app.end_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            if s_utc.tzinfo is None:
                s_utc = s_utc.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            if e_utc.tzinfo is None:
                e_utc = e_utc.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

            if s_utc >= e_utc:
                raise AppException(422, "start_at must be strictly earlier than end_at", "Unprocessable Entity")

            if s_utc < MIN_APPOINTMENT_TIME or e_utc > MAX_APPOINTMENT_TIME:
                raise AppException(
                    422,
                    f"Appointment times must be between {MIN_APPOINTMENT_TIME.isoformat()} and {MAX_APPOINTMENT_TIME.isoformat()}. Got start={s_utc.isoformat()}, end={e_utc.isoformat()}",
                    "Unprocessable Entity",
                )

            # Check for conflicts in new time slot
            conflicting_app = db.scalar(
                select(AppointmentModel).where(
                    AppointmentModel.id != app.id,
                    AppointmentModel.room_id == app.room_id,
                    AppointmentModel.status.in_([AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value]),
                    (s_utc < app.end_at) & (app.start_at < e_utc),
                )
            )
            if conflicting_app:
                raise AppException(
                    409,
                    f"Conflicting appointment exists during time slot [{s_utc.isoformat()}, {e_utc.isoformat()}): "
                    f"existing appointment {conflicting_app.id} ({conflicting_app.start_at.isoformat()} - {conflicting_app.end_at.isoformat()})",
                    "Conflict",
                )

            app.start_at = s_utc
            app.end_at = e_utc

        if payload.reason is not None:
            app.reason = payload.reason.strip()

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(app)
        return app

    ) -> RoomModel:

            raise AppException(403, "Only admins may manage rooms", "Forbidden")

        if room_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        room = db.scalar(
            select(RoomModel).where(RoomModel.id == room_id, RoomModel.is_deleted == False)
        )
        if not room:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        fields_set = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        if not fields_set:
            raise AppException(400, "At least one field must be updated", "Bad Request")

        if payload.name is not None and payload.name != room.name:
            dup = db.scalar(
                select(RoomModel).where(
                    RoomModel.name == payload.name,
                    RoomModel.id != room_id,
                    RoomModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )
            if dup:
                raise AppException(409, f"Room name '{payload.name}' already exists", "Conflict")
            room.name = payload.name

        if payload.room_type is not None:
            room.room_type = payload.room_type.value

        if payload.capacity is not None:
            room.capacity = payload.capacity

        if payload.active is not None:
            if payload.active is False and room.active is True:
                # REQ-3-008: A room may be deactivated only if it has no SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointment
                active_appt = db.scalar(
                    select(AppointmentModel)
                    .where(
                        AppointmentModel.room_id == room_id,
                        AppointmentModel.status.in_(
                            [
                                AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value,
                                AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value,
                            ]
                        ),
                    )
                    .limit(1)
                )
                if active_appt:
                    raise AppException(
                        409,
                        "Cannot deactivate room while SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointments exist",
                        "Conflict",
                    )
            room.active = payload.active

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(room)
        return room

    def create_appointment(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        payload: AppointmentCreateRequest,
    ) -> AppointmentModel:
        # REQ-3-001: Validate positive ids
        if payload.animal_id <= 0 or payload.room_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(404, "animal_id and room_id must be positive integers", "Not Found")

        # REQ-3-002: Load room
        room = db.scalar(select(RoomModel).where(RoomModel.id == payload.room_id, RoomModel.is_deleted == False))
        if not room:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {payload.room_id} not found", "Not Found")
        if not room.active:
            raise AppException(409, f"Room {payload.room_id} is inactive", "Conflict")

        # REQ-3-003: Load animal
        animal = db.scalar(
            select(PatientAnimalModel).where(PatientAnimalModel.id == payload.animal_id)
        )
        if not animal:
            raise AppException(404, f"Animal {payload.animal_id} not found", "Not Found")
        if not animal.active:
            raise AppException(409, f"Animal {payload.animal_id} is inactive", "Conflict")

        # REQ-3-009: Caller must own animal or be admin
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and animal.client_account_id != current_user.id:
            raise AppException(403, "Access denied: caller does not own this animal", "Forbidden")

        # REQ-3-004: Validate trimmed reason, start_at, end_at, and duration
        trimmed_reason = payload.reason.strip()
        if len(trimmed_reason) < 3 or len(trimmed_reason) > 250:
            raise AppException(422, "reason must be 3..250 trimmed characters", "Unprocessable Entity")

        s_utc = normalize_utc(payload.start_at)
        e_utc = normalize_utc(payload.end_at)

        if e_utc <= s_utc:
            raise AppException(422, "end_at must be strictly later than start_at", "Unprocessable Entity")
        if (e_utc - s_utc).total_seconds() / 60 < 15 or (e_utc - s_utc).total_seconds() / 60 > 240:
            raise AppException(422, "appointment duration must be between 15 and 240 minutes", "Unprocessable Entity")

        # REQ-3-005: Check for scheduling conflicts
        conflicting_app = db.scalar(
            select(AppointmentModel)
            .where(
                AppointmentModel.room_id == payload.room_id,
                AppointmentModel.status.in_([AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value]),
                AppointmentModel.start_at < e_utc,
                AppointmentModel.end_at > s_utc,
            )
        )
        if conflicting_app:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Room {payload.room_id} has scheduling conflict: {conflicting_app.id}",
                "Conflict",
            )

        # Create scheduled appointment
        app = AppointmentModel(
            animal_id=payload.animal_id,
            room_id=payload.room_id,
            reason=trimmed_reason,
            start_at=s_utc,
            end_at=e_utc,
            status=AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value,
        )
        db.add(app)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(app)
        return app
